statement: Written before any DepMap release newer than 24Q4 was downloaded or viewed by this project.

rules.new_lines: ModelIDs with a Broad Avana (library AV) CRISPR screen in the newer release that appear in NONE of the 24Q4 sets used here (discovery, held-out, Sanger; 1162 ModelIDs listed in cache meta.pkl).
rules.gene_effect: Chronos gene effect for the new lines, from the newer release's Avana screen-level gene effects (ScreenGeneEffect, library AV, as in prep.py) or CRISPRGeneEffect if screen-level files are absent. Genes missing in the newer release make that pair untestable.
rules.biomarkers: Same definitions as 24Q4 prep.py: MUT = damaging-mutation matrix > 0; HOT = hotspot matrix > 0; LOSS = log2(TPM+1) < 1 in the newer release's protein-coding expression matrix (the 'normally expressed' gene set is the one already fixed by 24Q4). ~MUT = no damaging mutation.
rules.lineage: OncotreeLineage from the newer release's Model.csv.
rules.test: Lineage-adjusted regression of gene effect on the biomarker within the new lines only (the same Frisch-Waugh-Lovell test as stats.py); one-sided (altered lines MORE dependent).
rules.verdicts: replicated: p < 0.01 and beta < 0. not replicated: testable but p >= 0.01 or beta >= 0. untestable: fewer than 3 altered or 3 unaltered new lines with both data types, or no within-lineage variation.
rules.family: Benjamini-Hochberg at 5% across all testable pairs in this file, reported alongside per-pair verdicts.
rules.secondary: Sign test: among testable LEAD+CANDIDATES pairs, the fraction with beta < 0, against 50%.
rules.calibration: CONTROLS are established biology. Their replication rate in the new lines estimates the power of this test, so a candidate's failure is read against it.
rules.sanity: For ModelIDs present in BOTH 24Q4 and the newer release, report agreement of each biomarker's calls between releases; a biomarker with < 90% agreement is flagged (definition drift), not dropped.

predictions.candidates: Most testable candidates have beta < 0; fewer replicate at p < 0.01 than controls do, because there are few new altered lines.
predictions.confound_check: LOSS_CRY1 -> MEF2B replicates only if the new lines include B-cell lymphomas with CRY1 loss; if it replicates, that still does not separate biomarker from lymphoma subtype.
